title: ShapeRuleId
description: A shape rule of the scrub registry: anthropic, openai-style (an sk- key), aws (an access key id), google, github, private-key (a PEM private key), bearer, key-assignment (a value after a key's name and = or :), openbao (OpenBao and Vault tokens), doppler, onepassword (a service-account token) or bitwarden (an access token).
